changed_in.5.3: Glues position information onto the message only when the message is really a string. 5.1 and 5.2 treat a number as one too, so `error(42)` raises there with a string carrying a chunk and a line in front of the digits, and from here on it raises with the number `42` and no position at all. `level` also has to hold an exact whole-number value now; one carrying a fraction used to be truncated towards zero and now raises.
changed_in.5.5: An error object of `nil` is replaced by a string before it propagates, so `error(nil)` reaches a catcher as a string. Earlier versions hand the `nil` straight through.
